checkpoint.title: Cerulean: Water Pulse, Potions, a GRIND until the rival is winnable, then saved below his trigger

events.why: TM03 Water Pulse in place of Tail Whip, unless the lead knows it or there is no TM03
out of the Center to the Mart's clerk
3 Potions: the GRIND fights wild battles only with 2 or more; 2 Awakenings for the rival's Sleep Powder
west out of the city along Route 4's lower road onto its grass's east edge
wild battles to Lv22, where console B's Wartortle beat the rival (m56); the nurse when hurt or low on PP
back to the Center: the rival's battle starts at full HP and PP
out of the Center, north up to (23, 7), short of the trigger row 6

checkpoint: Before the rival north of Cerulean (05.04), from the Center: first TM03 Water Pulse over Tail Whip, if the lead doesn't know it yet, so the GRIND's sim plays it (a run without TM03 from Misty skips the step). Then 3 Potions at the Mart (CeruleanCity_Mart_Items: POTION is row 3, 300 each; Mt. Moon's trainers leave well over the floor) and 2 Awakenings (row 6, 250 each; pokefirered items.json) for the rival's Bulbasaur's Sleep Powder (console B, m56: asleep at 34/65 HP, it fainted two turns later with 15 Potions), 1400 of the floor's 1500. Then a GRIND on Route 4's grass east of Mt. Moon (75..86, 11..17; Spearow, Rattata, Ekans and Mankey around Lv10, about 80 EXP each), healing at the Center, until the battle sim beats the rival 05.04 fights 50% or more: the win chance his battle refuses below. Console B's Wartortle (Lv22, 65 HP, Water Pulse) is about 42% there and 62% at Lv23; Lv28 (about 88%, some 120 battles from Lv22) is the cap. Then the nurse, and the save on (23, 7), the tile below his trigger: his battle is its own checkpoint, 05.04, verified and retried from this save.
